_doc: Customer-Deep-Link-1 — grammar-owned semantic destination map. Lives next to copy/{en,de,ru}.json so the grammar kernel owns BOTH narrative and routing. Transports (push/email/sms/in-app) resolve a (surface, params) tuple to their own concrete URL — they do NOT make semantic destination decisions. Locale-invariant by design: there is no per-language deep-link map.
_invariants: 1) Every key in EVENT_TO_SURFACE must be on the customer notification allowlist (Customer-Notify-1 NotificationKey). 2) Surface value must be in SURFACES list. 3) Route templates must reference only declared params. 4) Forbidden-route eventTypes (ocr.*/correlation.*/evidence.*/internal.*/suspicion.*) NEVER appear here. 5) routes.mobile and routes.web MUST both be present for every surface — channel isolation is for tone, not for destination.
_route_template_doc: Tokens in {curly braces} are bound from `params`. Templates with optional params append `?focus={itemId}` only when itemId is bound. mobile = Expo Router path. web = Vite SPA path on the customer web surface. Email CTAs reuse the web route. SMS does not carry URLs in Notify-1/2/3 — sms transport ignores routes by design.
_focus_token: When `itemId` is bound for a timeline destination, append `?focus={itemId}` to both mobile and web routes. Other surfaces ignore itemId.
